# Project rules

- Use the Next.js App Router with TypeScript.
- Use server components by default.
- Add "use client" only when client-side state or browser APIs are required.
- Never use hex colours or hardcoded fonts in components.
- Use semantic theme tokens such as bg-background, text-foreground, bg-brand, text-accent, bg-surface, and font-heading.
- Navigation and categories must come from src/config/brand.ts.
- Product images must use a 4:5 aspect ratio with aspect-[4/5].
- Keep components small and single-purpose.
- Use mobile-first styling.
